text: たたかいかたを　おしえて

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた added to a verb's stem means 'the way of doing it'. たたかいかた = 'how to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て form on its own at the end is a casual request, like てください without the ください. おしえて = 'teach me, please'.
